chopin.data 0.0.1
  • Reference

    Contaminant characteristics and analytical limits

    contam_info.Rd

    A reference table describing the contaminants analysed in the CHOPIN project. The dataset contains chemical identifiers, contaminant families and sub-families, selected physicochemical properties, carbon-chain length, and analytical detection and quantification limits for sediment and biota samples.

    Format

    A tibble with 53 rows and 11 variables:

    chemical

    Character. Internal chemical identifier used in datasets and analysis scripts.

    chem_label

    Character. Display label used for figures and tables.

    family

    Character. Main contaminant family: "PFAS", "PCB", or "HBCDD".

    sub_family

    Character. Chemical sub-family, mainly defined for PFAS compounds (e.g. "PFCAs", "PFSAs", "FOSAs", "FOSAAs", "FTSAs", "di.PAPs"). Missing for PCB and HBCDD compounds.

    sub_family_name

    Character. Full name of the chemical sub-family. Mainly available for PFAS compounds.

    logKow

    Numeric. Octanol-water partition coefficient expressed as \(\log_{10}(K_{ow})\). Available for PCB congeners in the current dataset.

    n_carbon

    Numeric. Number of carbon atoms in the perfluorinated carbon chain. Available for selected PFAS compounds.

    linearity_domain_sediment

    Character. Analytical calibration linearity range used for sediment samples. Available for PCB congeners.

    LOD_sediment

    Numeric. Limit of detection for sediment samples.

    LOQ_sediment

    Numeric. Limit of quantification for sediment samples.

    LOQ_biote

    Numeric. Limit of quantification for biota samples.

    Source

    CHOPIN project analytical dataset.

    Details

    Missing values indicate that the corresponding information was not available, not applicable to the contaminant family, or not included in the analytical dataset.
